title: Reorder List
description:
A linked list has nodes `L0 -> L1 -> L2 -> ... -> Ln`. Rearrange its nodes into the order

`L0 -> Ln -> L1 -> Ln-1 -> L2 -> Ln-2 -> ...`

taking alternately from the front and the back. Change the links between the existing nodes; do not change the values stored in them.

The method returns nothing. The judge prints the list starting from the original `head` after your method finishes.
constraints: The number of nodes is between 1 and 5 * 10^4

examples.explanation: Front, back, front, back...: 10, 50, 20, 40, then the middle node 30.
With two nodes the order does not change.
A single node stays as it is.

seedMeta.notes: In-place problem: the driver prints the list from the original head after the call.
